rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. Welcome to the Imperator's feast! How do you feel? Are you satisfied?
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Haha, it can't be helped. We still need to save some funds for the forces in the coming day. We do have several Titans to deal with, after all.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Right, a lot of events at this banquet have been organized by me, advisor of the Flame-Chase Army. I already set up a few projects according to the requests of a few people for the banquet. If you have something you want, you can come find me too.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: What new projects have you added?
Well, to give an example, the wine-stomper is something that Seneca and Labienus requested.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: To ensure the wine-stomping can proceed smoothly, we also hired a priest of Phagousa. They're all... veteran stompers...
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: How about you add some trashcans for me.
Trash... cans? I... dear guest, are you worried about hygiene? Don't worry, we have someone specifically here to clean things up!
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: How about you put in a Dreampool for me.
Dream... pool? I never heard of this. Do you have insomnia, dear guest? Don't worry, the Imperator does not lack for great doctors!
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Ar... cade? I never heard of such a thing. However, at Styxia there are places to frolic and play everywhere. Is the banquet unsatisfactory? Are the items planned not interesting enough...
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: We thank you for your valuable advice. The banquet is Dux Gladiorum's most favorite thing. Ever since she joined us, banquets have become routine for the Flame-Chasers.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: I hope you can enjoy this moment as well. As for me, I have a great many preparations that I must take charge of, so I never quite can fully enjoy this celebration. Haha.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius
